visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler girl with dark bangs and pigtails stands in a modern living room with light-colored wooden floors. She is dressed in a green-and-white horizontal striped shirt and cream ribbed trousers. In the background, a black robotic vacuum cleaner sits at its charging station next to a white air purifier. She eventually squats down, looking directly at the camera with a curious expression. (2) The scene shifts to the toddler sitting on an adult's lap near a large window providing bright natural light. She is now wearing a fluffy brown teddy-bear-style fleece jacket. The adult's arms are visible holding her securely. The girl looks up at the adult while gesturing with her small hands, her facial expressions shifting between concentration and a shy smile. (3) A closer shot shows the girl still in the brown fleece, sitting comfortably. She raises her hand and gives a clear thumbs-up gesture towards the camera, followed by a wide, joyous smile that shows her teeth. Her hair is slightly messy, and she looks energetic. The background is softly blurred but shows indoor domestic elements. (4) The toddler is now at a dining table, wearing a light yellow sweatshirt decorated with various cartoon illustrations. She is sitting next to an adult woman whose face is partially visible. The girl is actively moving her arms and hands while looking around the room. A ginger cat can be seen sleeping on a sofa in the background behind them. (5) The video concludes with a flat, light pink graphic background. In the center, a simplified cartoon illustration of the toddler girl sitting with an orange is displayed. Below the illustration, the text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE" appears in a clean, white sans-serif font, serving as a branded outro.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the recognizable acoustic guitar strumming and vocals of a Mandopop song. A toddler’s high-pitched, thin voice attempts to sing along, mimicking the lyrics with soft, rounded phonemes. The BGM tempo is moderate (approx 80 BPM) with a warm acoustic texture. No significant background noise is present, suggesting a quiet indoor recording. (2) A transient giggle from an adult woman marks a shift. The child continues to sing, her pitch rising as she attempts higher notes. The acoustic guitar provides a rhythmic backbone. The child’s vocal intensity is moderate, sounding focused. A slight rustle of fabric is heard as the child moves on the adult's lap. (3) The music stops abruptly, replaced by clean studio-like silence. The adult female voice says a phrase with clear, professional articulation. The child immediately repeats the word "Zan" with high vocal arousal and a sharp, percussive ending. A burst of loud, joyous laughter from the adult follows, creating a high-arousal acoustic peak. (4) A new, more upbeat electronic-pop track with a faster tempo (approx 120 BPM) and bright synthesizer textures starts. The child sings a repetitive "Hou Yo" phrase with high intensity and energy. Her voice is sharp and clear, cutting through the synthesized beat. The adult provides low-volume vocal support in the background. (5) The upbeat music fades out quickly into a short, melodic chime jingle that lasts less than two seconds. The overall acoustic environment remains very clean with high signal-to-noise ratio, ending with a soft digital fade-out that leaves only the faint room tone before total silence.
